register.description: Create your Olivin account. We will send a confirmation code to the email address you provide.

register.consentMarketing: I want to receive marketing information by email (optional).

mfa.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app or a recovery code to finish signing in.

passwordReset.description: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a code to set a new password.
passwordReset.requestFailed: Could not send the reset code. Try again.
passwordReset.confirmDescription: Enter the code from the email and your new password.
